description: Run a whole shell script on linux with outbound internet. Pass it inline, or script_key for one saved under scripts/. Returns exit code + output. Owner env vars preloaded.

script.description: The complete shell script (sh -e), for a one-off. For a SAVED script use script_key instead — smaller payload, and what runs is what is stored. Owner secrets are already env vars — reference $NAME, never a value. 15 min ceiling; /tmp is scratch.

script_key.description: Cabinet key of a saved script: 'scripts/<name>' for one you run on request, or 'automations/approved/external/<name>' for one that has passed review and can be scheduled. If both this and script are given, script wins and the run logs it.
